_comment: Human-judged expectations, NOT derived from the scoring formula. Each ranking case gives either a ready 'profile' or a free-text 'query' (parsed first, so it tests the whole pipeline). ideal_ids = songs the listener would be delighted by (grade 2); acceptable_ids = fine (grade 1); forbidden_ids = songs that must NOT appear in the top k. All ids refer to data/songs.csv. Review and edit this file; the evaluation is only as good as these judgments. paraphrase_groups: different wordings of one intent; every wording must meet 'expected' and the parsed energies must agree within 0.25. adversarial_cases: injection, other languages, gibberish, off-topic and very long input; the profile must be safe (catalog labels only, energy in range) and meet any 'expected' fields (an empty genre or mood means the parser must not invent one). Calm expectations use energy_max 0.45, strictly below the parser's default energy of 0.5, so a parser that understood nothing cannot pass them by accident. Adversarial 'understanding_max' means the parser must rate the input as poorly understood (junk in, low understanding out); 'understanding_min' means a clear request must not be rated as confusing.
